svg.title: One token through the toy top-two expert layer
svg.desc: The router receives x and emits four logits, 2, 0, 3, minus 1. Top-two selects experts 2 and 0, then softmax over logits 3 and 2 gives weights approximately 0.731 and 0.269. Evaluate E2 and E0 on the same x and add their weighted outputs. Experts 1 and 3 are not evaluated for this token.
